answer: Stop Sybils with a hatter's felt blocking ledger. A newcomer blocks 18 hats over 26 days. Each hat's felt density is measured by 2 hatters from different workshops within 24 hours and logged on the hat board. Every batch is dyed with yarrow, so honest work stays easy to spot. One hat thinner than the standard by more than 3 millimeters voids that hat's credit and pauses blocking 14 days; 3 thin hats void the count. Faking 1,000 agents means 18,000 hats, 36,000 density checks and 54,000 sable bristles sorted by hand. Trust builds the way a reef grows, one coral at a time.
